1.7.0.en: GPU usage, internet access and internet latency, each with its own Flow cards. Flows can now react when a chosen app or background process starts or stops. A Mac with both Ethernet and Wi-Fi is found again on its other address when one stops answering. The new readings need version 1.7.0 of the Mac agent.

1.6.0.en: Redrawn icons that show correctly everywhere in Homey, instead of as plain blocks. A Mac that moves to another address is picked up again on its own, and adding a Mac now warns when it answers on a network your Homey cannot reach.

1.5.2.en: Idle time, screen lock and display state, network speed, memory pressure, thermal state, disk health, Time Machine backups and external drives, each with its own Flow cards. New actions to keep the Mac awake, let it sleep again and speak text. Cleaner pairing screen and widget.

1.5.0.en: Idle time, screen lock and display state, network speed, memory pressure, thermal state, disk health, Time Machine backups and external drives. New Flow cards for all of these, plus keep awake, allow sleep, speak text and app running. Link to the community topic.

1.0.0.en: Initial release. Monitor Apple silicon Macs from Homey: temperatures, CPU, memory, disk space, fan speed and power, with Flow cards to sleep, wake, lock, notify, run commands, restart or shut down, and a dashboard widget.
